summary: No omission identified at the external cuSPARSE contract boundary for valid reviewed workload dimensions. MPI partitions all rows contiguously by quotient/remainder, derives each complete nonzero slice from its two global CSR row offsets, scatters all values/columns, rebases all localDim+1 offsets and broadcasts the entire x vector. Every rank with rows initializes localDim-by-globalDim double CSR and matching full-x/local-y descriptors. Timed compiled host code performs one non-transpose alpha=1/beta=0 CSR_ALG1 cuSPARSE SpMV per parsed iteration, synchronizes the device and copies all local output each time, before the ending clock. Zero-row ranks have no mathematical work and skip calls. There is no GPU-versus-CPU split or selected timed CPU fallback: the CPU function is used only for the optional untimed rank-zero reference. Static conclusion is at the documented external-library contract boundary: vendor device instructions and runtime behavior were not inspected. Retained source-level integer-range, unchecked cuSPARSE return-code and zero-size-allocation concerns are not observed work-count failures.
